title: ChatGPT vs Google Gemini: Free vs Paid, Workflows and Pricing
metaDescription: Compare ChatGPT and Google Gemini across free and paid plans ($20/mo), Google Workspace integration, coding, research, voice, APIs, and daily workflows.
introSummary: ChatGPT and Google Gemini are both general-purpose multimodal AI assistants with capable free tiers and ~$20/month flagship consumer plans, but they are built around different work environments. ChatGPT operates as a standalone workspace featuring an interactive Canvas editor, sandboxed Python data analysis, persistent Projects, and native ChatGPT Images generation. Google Gemini connects directly into Google Workspace apps (Gmail, Docs, Drive, Sheets, Slides, and Meet) and bundles 2 TB of Google One cloud storage on its standard consumer paid plan.

quickAnswer.text: Choose ChatGPT if you want a standalone workspace for iterative writing and coding in Canvas, Python-based spreadsheet analysis, persistent Projects, and native image generation.
Choose Google Gemini if your daily work lives in Gmail, Google Docs, Drive, Sheets, Slides, and Meet and you want native side-panel assistance across your Google account.
Both offer free tiers and ~$20/month entry paid plans: ChatGPT Plus costs $20/month, while Google AI Pro (Gemini Advanced) costs $19.99/month and bundles 2 TB of Google One storage.

Consumer chat subscriptions do not include developer API credits on either platform: OpenAI bills API usage separately via the OpenAI Platform, while Google provides developer API access through Google AI Studio and Vertex AI.

keyDifferences.description: Google Gemini connects natively to Gmail, Google Docs, Drive, Sheets, Slides, and Meet via Workspace extensions and side panels. ChatGPT operates as a dedicated workspace with Projects, Custom GPTs, Canvas, and cloud file connectors.

Both assistants provide a free tier for everyday chat, web search, and multimodal prompts. Flagship consumer plans start around $20/month (ChatGPT Plus at $20/month; Google AI Pro with Gemini Advanced at $19.99/month including 2 TB of Google One storage), while high-usage tiers (ChatGPT Pro at $200/month; Google AI Ultra at $249.99/month) target heavy reasoning and media workloads.

keyDifferences.topic: Product Scope: Apps, Models, APIs & Enterprise
keyDifferences.description: Both ecosystems separate consumer apps (chatgpt.com and gemini.google.com), underlying model families (OpenAI GPT and reasoning series vs Google Gemini models), business plans (ChatGPT Team/Enterprise vs Google Workspace with Gemini), and usage-billed developer APIs (OpenAI Platform API vs Google AI Studio and Vertex AI).

Both assistants support live web search and multi-step Deep Research reports. Gemini can cross-reference web findings directly against files in your Google Drive, whereas ChatGPT pairs web search with uploaded files and Python data execution inside Projects.

ChatGPT includes an interactive Canvas editor for side-by-side writing and code revisions plus a sandboxed Python environment (Advanced Data Analysis) for inspecting spreadsheets and charts. Gemini offers its own Canvas workspace, one-click export to Google Docs, Sheets, and Google Colab, and large-context document and code review.

ChatGPT features Advanced Voice Mode for spoken dialogue and native image creation and editing via ChatGPT Images. Gemini offers Gemini Live for conversational voice with camera and screen sharing alongside Imagen-powered image generation.

faqCandidates.question: Is ChatGPT or Google Gemini better on the free plan?
faqCandidates.answer: Both free plans cover everyday writing, web search, voice chat, and image prompts. ChatGPT Free gives you limited access to OpenAI's flagship models, ChatGPT Search, and native image generation, while Gemini Free provides fast responses with Google Search grounding and optional extensions for Gmail, Docs, and Drive. If you rely on Google apps daily, Gemini Free connects to them more directly; if you want a standalone workspace with Custom GPTs and Canvas, ChatGPT Free is stronger.

faqCandidates.question: How do ChatGPT Plus and Google Gemini paid plans compare on price?
faqCandidates.answer: Their flagship consumer plans cost almost the same: ChatGPT Plus is $20/month and Google AI Pro (which includes Gemini Advanced) is $19.99/month. The key value difference is bundling: Google AI Pro includes 2 TB of Google One cloud storage and Gemini side panels in personal Gmail and Docs, whereas ChatGPT Plus focuses on higher usage limits for OpenAI reasoning models, Advanced Data Analysis, Projects, and Canvas. Both also offer high-capacity plans (ChatGPT Pro at $200/month and Google AI Ultra at $249.99/month).

faqCandidates.question: Which assistant integrates natively with Google Workspace (Docs, Gmail, Drive, Sheets)?
faqCandidates.answer: Google Gemini offers native integration across Google Workspace. On eligible Google One AI plans and Google Workspace Business or Enterprise tiers, Gemini appears directly inside Gmail, Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, and Meet to draft replies, summarise threads, build tables, and search Drive files. ChatGPT can read files via Google Drive connectors, but it does not live inside the Google Workspace interface.

faqCandidates.question: Why does the catalogue table list API available as No for ChatGPT and Yes for Google Gemini?
faqCandidates.answer: In WhichAIPick's tool directory, the consumer ChatGPT application (/tools/chatgpt/) is catalogued separately from OpenAI's developer platform (/tools/openai-api/), whereas the Google Gemini profile (/tools/google-gemini/) records both the Gemini assistant and Google's developer API availability. In practice, both companies offer full developer APIs (OpenAI Platform API and Google AI Studio / Vertex AI), and neither includes API token credits inside a $20/month consumer chat subscription.

faqCandidates.question: Which is better for coding and spreadsheet data analysis: ChatGPT or Gemini?
faqCandidates.answer: ChatGPT is well suited for interactive coding and spreadsheet analysis because Canvas supports side-by-side code revisions and Advanced Data Analysis runs Python scripts in a sandboxed environment to clean CSV or Excel files and plot charts. Google Gemini is well suited when you want to inspect large multi-file codebases, export Python code directly to Google Colab, or send generated tables straight into Google Sheets.

faqCandidates.question: Can I use ChatGPT or Google Gemini for HR, operations, and team workflows?
faqCandidates.answer: Yes. Teams running on Google Workspace often prefer Gemini because it summarises Google Meet interviews, drafts emails in Gmail, and retrieves HR policies stored in Google Drive under existing Workspace permissions. Standalone teams often choose ChatGPT Team ($25-$30/user/month) to build shared Projects and Custom GPTs for onboarding guides, rubric evaluation, and internal documentation.

faqCandidates.question: Do ChatGPT and Google Gemini train on my business or workspace data?
faqCandidates.answer: On business and enterprise tiers (ChatGPT Team, ChatGPT Enterprise, OpenAI API, and Google Workspace Business/Enterprise with Gemini), both providers state in their official terms that organisation prompts and files are not used to train public foundation models. On consumer Free and $20/month plans, chat history may be used to improve models unless you disable model training or activity history in your account settings.
